name: Screenshot
description: Capture the screen and keep a local screenshot history in DBX. Saving can copy the image to the clipboard (overwrites current clipboard contents; toggle in settings).
releaseNotes: 0.1.1: declare host.binary; Windows interactive region capture; package LICENSE; clean capture tmp on failure/clear; disclose default copy-to-clipboard overwrites the system clipboard.

zh-CN.name: 截图
zh-CN.description: 截取屏幕并在 DBX 中保存本机截图历史。保存后可复制到剪贴板（会覆盖当前剪贴板内容，可在设置中关闭）。
